      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds `setprunelock` and `listprunelocks` methods in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds RPC methods solving an explicit gap requested and tested by external wallet and indexer developers. Reviewers noted this is 'needed to support external indexers on a pruned node' and avoids blocks needed for rescan being pruned away."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to test_runner.py and test/functional/rpc_prunelock.py test the new RPC feature specifically.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Functional test and fuzz additions pin the behavior of the new prune lock RPC rather than modifying shared test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp solely to wire up the `-prunelock` startup flag.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adding a startup argument whose sole purpose is configuring prune locks belongs to the feature's area rather than general utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies block file pruning management interfaces in src/node/blockstorage.h and src/node/blockstorage.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Exposes manual control over `BlockManager` prune locks to protect blocks from deletion at runtime. The change is small and does not affect core chainstate or consensus logic, but provides a clear mechanism for external tools interacting with block storage."
    }
